note: Eighth shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the fabric and materials shop, with teal walls and a pale pine plank floor. LANDMARK: the whole back wall of pine shelves stacked with colourful fabric bolts. The doorway on the far left shows the butter-yellow corner shop with its bay window (way back); the doorway on the far right opens into the glass greenhouse of the florist's (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zoom: the timber planks against the pillar (z1).
